boundary: Legacy Model Year 2020 North American R4045 research candidate frozen to base code 06W5N, its 1,200 U.S. gallon stainless tank, 4920 120-foot steel boom, 5165 20-inch off-center stainless plumbing and 5465 five-sensor boom leveling. Manufacturer facts constrain identity, engine power, tank capacity, crop clearance, tread range and the selected 36.576 m boom span.
